title: A Pareto superior incentive scheme for residential electricity conservation
abstract: Shenzhen’s residential inclining tier rates are designed to encourage electricity conservation. However, the rates for customers with relatively low consumption fall below Shenzhen’s estimated marginal generation cost, leading to economically inefficient overconsumption. Therefore, we propose an incentive scheme with voluntary participation to promote residential electricity conservation. We further demonstrate that this scheme is Pareto superior, as its implementation can benefit participating customers without adversely affecting the electric utility or non-participating customers.
abstract_zh: 深圳的居民阶梯电价旨在鼓励节约用电。然而，低用电量客户的电价低于深圳估计的边际发电成本，导致经济上低效的过度消费。因此，我们提出一种自愿参与的激励方案，以促进居民节约用电。我们进一步证明，该方案具有帕累托改进性：其实施能够使参与的用户受益，同时不会对电力公司或未参与的用户造成不利影响。

title: Protectionism's adverse impact on renewable energy deployment: evidence from the European Union's import duties on China-made photovoltaic panels
abstract: Responding to the Paris Agreement on deep decarbonization, many countries have adopted industrial policies to promote their domestic manufacture of renewable energy equipment. If accompanied by protectionism, such policies impede renewable energy deployment that reduces the world's CO 2 emissions caused by production and consumption of fossil fuels. Using the quasi-natural experiment data for 36 OECD countries in 2011–2018, this paper econometrically documents the adverse impact of protectionism on renewable energy deployment based on the European Union's (EU's) anti-dumping and anti-subsidy import duties that took effect in December 2013 on China-made photovoltaic panels (CPP). Its key finding is that these duties had reduced the annual growth in the EU's solar energy share of total electricity generation. This statistically significant ( p -value ≤0.05) finding's policy implication is that had the EU not imposed these duties, its solar energy share growth could have been ∼0.7 % per year instead of the observed ∼0.2 % per year in the 2014–2018 period. The estimated difference of ∼0.5 % suggests an increase of ∼0.75 % in the EU electricity industry's CO 2 emissions. Thankfully, the EU's import duties on CPP expired at the end of 2018, thus eliminating one of the adverse effects of protectionism on the world's quest for a clean and sustainable electricity future. • Protectionism slows down renewable energy deployment. • The EU's trade protectionism against China's solar PV goods hindered energy transition. • The EU's solar share in electricity could have grown 0.5 % higher without protectionism. • Subsidies are needed for decarbonization, but they may lead to trade protectionism. • New trade rules are needed for environmental goods.
abstract_zh: 为应对《巴黎协定》关于深度脱碳的要求，许多国家采取了产业政策，以促进本国可再生能源设备的制造。若这些政策伴随保护主义，将阻碍可再生能源的推广，而可再生能源本可减少世界因化石燃料生产和消费而产生的二氧化碳排放。本文利用2011–2018年36个经合组织（OECD）国家的准自然实验数据，计量检验了保护主义对可再生能源推广的不利影响。该研究以欧盟于2013年12月起对中国产光伏板（CPP）征收的反倾销和反补贴进口关税为基础。其核心发现是，这些关税降低了欧盟太阳能发电在总发电量中占比的年增长幅度。该发现具有统计显著性（p值≤0.05）。其政策含义是：若欧盟未征收这些关税，2014–2018年间其太阳能发电份额的年增长率本可达到约0.7%，而实际仅为约0.2%。约0.5%的差额意味着欧盟电力行业的二氧化碳排放量增加了约0.75%。值得庆幸的是，欧盟对光伏产品的进口关税已于2018年底到期，从而消除了保护主义对世界迈向清洁、可持续电力未来的不利影响之一。• 保护主义减缓可再生能源的推广。• 欧盟针对中国太阳能光伏产品的贸易保护主义阻碍了能源转型。• 若无保护主义，欧盟太阳能在电力中的占比本可再高出0.5%。• 脱碳需要补贴，但补贴可能导致贸易保护主义。• 环境产品需要新的贸易规则。

Reforms of the Agricultural Bank of China: Can Policy and Commercial Objectives Be Reconciled?
abstract: This paper investigates the evolution of the ABC, from its reestablishment in 1979 as a state bank to the announcement of shareholding reform toward the end of 2008. The ambivalence of the government in reforming the ABC and the limitations of the reforms are studied. The concluding analysis examines the meanings and implications of the reforms and discusses how the ABC has been finding ways, by means of local experiments, to reconcile policy and commercial objectives.
abstract_zh: 本文考察中国农业银行的演变过程，从1979年作为国有银行重新设立，直至2008年底宣布股份制改革。文章研究了政府在农业银行改革问题上的矛盾态度，以及改革的局限性。结论部分分析了这些改革的意义与影响，并讨论了农业银行如何通过地方试验，寻求调和政策目标与商业目标的途径。
